body:
Milestone 9 (`project-pages`): six more project home pages now show a figure.

Each project gets `experiments/figure.py`, a stdlib-only script that parses the committed `results.txt` (no retyped numbers) and writes an SVG: `abstention-scoring` (payment vs reward scale), `ambient-bandit` (regret by policy), `calibration-hedging` (ECE vs rounds), `categorical-scores` (curvature per payment range), `chip-accel` (cells x cycles vs parallelism), `challenge-window` (window vs stake).

Verified: all six scripts run; SVGs rendered in Chromium and inspected; `python site/build.py` prints ok (400 projects, 3504 tests). No experiment code or results changed. Figures are of stylised or simulated results only.

Also adds the run line and a progress note in `PROJECTS.md`. `mirror-sync` and `mirror-guards` were already claimed by oss-monorepo PRs, so skipped.
